evals.name: quotacanary-mac-lucky
evals.prompt: I'm in the QuotaCanary repo (~/toppd). Make a launch video for QuotaCanary for Mac, the menu bar app under mac/. It's for the Product Hunt listing and a LinkedIn post, 16:9, around 25 seconds. Just make it, I'll react afterwards.
evals.expected_output: An MP4 (1920x1080, 20-30s) in a motion-video/ folder with brief.md (assumptions listed), storyboard.md and video.html; the Mac menu bar app shown as the product with real brand tokens (Canary Gold #FFC400, cream, Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains Mono), no em dashes, under ~4 words/second, a hook that is not 'Introducing'.

evals.name: reechee-d-app-grill
evals.prompt: grill me on a launch video for the new Reechee app (the D shell: top nav, the opportunities feed, reveal, take-it-to-your-agent). 25 seconds, 16:9, for LinkedIn. I have screenshots and two reference videos.
evals.expected_output: Four interview rounds with prefilled defaults, a storyboard shown for approval with word counts, a scene-one clip checkpoint, then a full MP4 (1920x1080, ~25s) in motion-video/ with brief.md and storyboard.md; Reechee brand (pink #EE2E7F, deep purple #390854, Bricolage Grotesque + Inter), sample-universe names (Halvorsen Logistics, Priya Natarajan), no credit/price wording, under ~4 words/second.
